name: Sales Order structure
definition: A Sales Order (Main OC) holds Deliveries (Delivery OCs). Each delivery holds one or more Articles, and each article holds a Colour/Size breakup with selling price. The list shows one row per order and article, with the order number repeated.

name: Sales Order sections
definition: The creation screen is one transaction page with Order Information (Sales Order No, Category, Buyer, Buyer Division/Dept, Order Season), Other Details, Delivery and Items, Instructions, Documents and History. The title reads Add Sales Order when new, Edit Sales Order when revising and Sales Order when only viewing.

name: Quick Fills (Copy Order)
definition: Fills a new order in one of two ways: copy from the Buyer Default Template (the template of the selected buyer, from Buyer Master › Default tab) or copy from an Existing Sales Order (all details including quantities; search by order number or style; the last 10 orders are listed).

name: Article selection modes
definition: Mode A is Style + Color + Size: one row per unique combination with Number of Sets, Size, Selling Price, Value and Total Quantity. Mode B is Style-wise grouping: one group per style with Color/Size, Quantity, Selling Price, Value, BOM and Total Quantity. A TBA colour/size line is always created by default.

name: Price Per
definition: Inherited from the Tech Pack, never typed on the order. It decides at which level the selling price is kept: Article (one price), Color (a price per colour, average shown), Size (a price per size, average shown) or Color/Size (a price per combination, average shown).
example: Price Per = Color: prices 10 for red and 14 for blue show an average price on the main screen.

name: Upcharge / Discount
definition: Driven by Price Per. The base selling price comes from the Tech Pack. A positive value is an upcharge, a negative value is a discount, and the final selling price is read-only: Base Selling Price ± Upcharge/Discount. Only when the setting "Enable Base Price and Upcharge in Summary OC" is ON; when OFF the Tech Pack price goes straight into Selling Price.

name: BOM selection on the order
definition: When several approved and accepted BOMs exist, the order picks the selling price of the latest accepted BOM. If the user selects a BOM for the article from the dropdown, the price of that BOM is used.

name: Buyer Style Reference (BSR)
definition: Shown under the article. Non-textile: taken from the Tech Pack, otherwise blank. Textile/fabric: taken first from the Linked Customer table for the selected buyer, then from the Tech Pack, otherwise blank. Whether the value can be edited follows the BSR configuration.

name: Extra Production % and Additional Quantity
definition: Extra Production % entered at the article header adds a percentage on top of the order quantity and is shown in its own grid under the Quantity Breakup on the Proforma Invoice and Print page. Additional Quantity is added in a separate tab with its own quantity, selling price and a reason from a dropdown. Both can be excluded from MRL generation by a setting, and the planned (PD) quantity must still equal the total OC quantity.

name: Packing Type
definition: Chosen per article: Solid Color / Solid Size (a single colour and size, existing popup), Solid Color / Assorted Size (a PP column; one colour only, ratios across sizes) and Multiple Prepack (PP ratios across colours and sizes). Price Per and its dropdown are not shown here, they come from the Tech Pack.

name: Add Qty breakup
definition: A tool that adds another, independent quantity grid under the same article, with a count of how many were added. It is enabled only for Solid Color / Assorted Size and Multiple Prepack. The packing type of an added grid is frozen, and each added grid can be deleted.

name: Inseam
definition: A size categorisation by inside leg length (Petite, Missy, Regular, Tall, Long, Short) so the same waist size can come in several length variants. Values are kept in the Size Master and chosen per size in the Color/Size popup.

name: Kit article
definition: A delivery cannot mix kit and non-kit articles. The first article chosen fixes the type and later selections show only that type. Kit articles are shown in grid view only, with the kit name and kit ID and an indicator.

name: Add Delivery
definition: Adds a new delivery by the Add Delivery button or the + beside Deliveries in the left panel (the + is for additional deliveries). The popup has Delivery Information and Article Information, all blank and editable, and the line shows Pending until confirmed, then Confirmed.

name: Copy Delivery
definition: Copies a delivery of the same order from the Action column or the left panel. A new blank delivery opens with the style already filled; delivery number, date and lines must be entered again, and everything stays editable.

name: Delete Delivery
definition: Removes one or several ticked deliveries after a confirmation that names them (for example Delivery 001, 002 and 003). A delivery article can be deleted until its GMPO or ASN has been created.

name: Split Delivery
definition: Splits a delivery quantity by Percentage (default) or by Quantity from the sidebar of the edit page. Only the delivery information is shown, and Save replaces Confirm while splitting.

name: Cancel Delivery
definition: Tick one or more deliveries, open the context menu, choose Cancel and enter remarks (required). After "Do you want to Cancel the selected Delivery Order(s)?" and OK the status turns Cancelled (red) and the remarks show on hover and in History.

name: Close Delivery
definition: Same steps as cancel with the Close option. The status turns Closed (orange); the delivery stays in the list and the remarks are kept.

name: Reopen Delivery
definition: Only a closed delivery can be reopened. Choose Reopen, enter remarks and confirm; the status becomes Open (green) and the delivery is editable again. On a delivery that is not closed the system says "Please Uncheck Confirmed Delivery OC."

name: Duplicate delivery check
definition: A delivery is refused when Delivery Buyer Order Ref, Buyer Delivery Date, OC Delivery Date and Mode of Shipment are all the same as an existing one. If any one of them differs the delivery is allowed.

name: Confirmed * status
definition: When a confirmed order has been revised and a delivery is kept in draft, the Delete button is disabled on both the list and the edit page.

name: History and activity timeline
definition: Every action is logged with date, time, user and remarks: status updates, approval trail (approver name, status, comments), comments and notes, and delivery actions such as "Delivery Order Closed (1) 12:22:02 PM 26/12/2026 Nishant Test Case". When an order is sent for approval the approver name shows in the timeline.

name: Revision Log
definition: Grid context-menu tool, enabled only when a confirmed order is revised. It opens the latest version in the Modified tab; versions are chosen from a multi-select header dropdown and load on the All, Modified and Inserted/Deleted tabs. Rows appear only when something changed: Version Change, Revision Authorised By, Reason for Revision, Delivery Name, header changes, Total Qty and UOM, Total Value and Currency, and quantity details (article, colour and size, qty, price, value).

name: Reason for revision and Revision Authorized By
definition: Both are mandatory text fields shown when the user chooses Revise from the grid context menu.

name: Cancel Sales Order
definition: Grid context menu › Cancel opens a warning that all Delivery OCs of the Main OC will be cancelled, then a mandatory remarks popup. On OK the order and all its deliveries are cancelled and the status becomes Cancelled. An order that is Saved, Cancelled or Closed cannot be cancelled: "You cannot cancel a Saved, Cancelled, or Closed Order."

name: Close Sales Order
definition: Grid context menu › Close opens a popup with mandatory remarks; on Close Order the status becomes Closed. A Cancelled or Closed order cannot be closed: "You cannot close a Cancelled or Closed Order."

name: Split / Shuffle DOC
definition: Moves quantity of a delivery to a new delivery or to an existing delivery of the same order. Target Sales Order = New: the target lookup is frozen, a Draft delivery is created on Load with all delivery information, articles, colours and sizes, prices and instructions copied, and the Buyer Order Reference is left blank for the user. Existing: pick one eligible target delivery and the quantities and values of both are recalculated.

name: Split / Shuffle target eligibility
definition: A target delivery must belong to the same Sales Order, buyer and style/OC, be Draft or editable, not Cancelled and not Closed, and the user must be able to modify it. The source delivery can never be its own target.

name: Split by quantity or percentage
definition: By Quantity the entered quantity is spread proportionately over the selected article colour/size lines and taken off the source. By Percentage each line moves Existing Quantity × Percentage ÷ 100, rounded to the UOM precision. Quantity must be above zero and not above the delivery quantity; percentage above 0 and not above 100.
example: 50 % of a 5,000 piece delivery: 2,500 stay, 2,500 move.

name: OC Notes
definition: A delivery can get Notes from the Notes action. The dropdown lists only active notes from Sales › Codes › OC Notes; each Save is its own "OC Note Added" entry in the activity timeline with note, user and time. Update Notes uploads an Excel to set notes on many orders. A deleted note stays in the timeline but cannot be picked again.
where_used: Delivery OC › Notes; Sales › Codes › OC Notes

name: Proforma Invoice and Print
definition: Proforma Invoice opens a page at delivery level. Print opens a page grouped by Delivery, Market or Destination. Both show a Sub Total column in the sales order currency and an Extra Production % grid under the Quantity Breakup.
example: 800 USD at 1 USD = 84 INR shows 67,200 INR.

name: Run MRP from the order
definition: Header context menu › Run MRP opens the level-wise material screen: MRL for a cost sheet order, the Pending MRP List for a BOM order.

name: Export
definition: Exports to Excel only what the list currently shows, respecting filters, sorting and page size.

name: ASN, GDN, invoice and dispatch links
definition: Under the Order Qty column ASN and GDN hyperlinks open a popup with the ASN and GDN quantities of that delivery. The Sales Invoice number opens Sales Invoice Detail (invoice no, date, qty, value). Dispatch opens the Buyer Dispatch Note: destination first, then dates, then articles, then a dispatch allocation grid and Material Re-Allocation with reserve and free stock.

name: BOM Information and Material Requirement Status
definition: The context menu opens the BOM of the delivery style in view mode, and the Material Status popup of the style in that delivery.

name: Delivery Update
definition: Edits Buyer Delivery Date, OC Delivery Date, Buyer Order Date, PCD Date, PO Packet Date and GAC Date in a grid without an OC revision. After Save the new dates show on the OC and the related screens.
where_used: Sales Order header › context menu, or Purchase Order from Buyer › Delivery Update

name: Ex-factory calculation
definition: A master keeps days against shipment mode, order company, buyer and buyer department. When the Buyer Delivery Date is entered the OC Delivery Date fills automatically that many days earlier. OC Delivery Date otherwise always follows the Buyer Delivery Date.
example: 10 days: buyer date 31 Mar → OC delivery date 21 Mar.

name: Approval value
definition: Set per approver: 0 means the document never goes for approval, -1 means it always does, and a limit above 0 means it goes for approval only when the order value exceeds the limit (a value equal to the limit does not).
example: Limit 1,000: an order of 1,000 is confirmed directly, 1,500 goes for approval.

name: Single-level approval
definition: The creator names one approver. After Confirm a popup sends the order for approval; the approver finds it under Home › Approval Centre › Sales Order › Pending Approval. Approval makes the status Confirmed; the history keeps approver, status, comments, date and time.

name: Multi-level approval
definition: Enabled for the document Sales Order in the Multi-Level Approval Settings (beside Purchase Order From Buyer). Creator → first approver (chosen by the creator) → next approver (chosen by the first, ending with a final approver). The order stays pending after each intermediate approval and becomes Confirmed only after the final one.
where_used: Admin › Company Setup › Multi level approval Settings

name: Multiple approval (parallel)
definition: More than one approver can be assigned so a missing approver does not block the order. One of them is the default shown in the dropdown, the others are selectable.

name: Auto price pickup from cost sheet
definition: On a new OC the selling price comes from the confirmed cost sheet or BOM for the style and destination. Prices are destination-wise in the Cost Sheet Summary.
example: Style 1, destination IN, cost sheet price 10: the OC price fills as 10.

name: Desync price
definition: A mismatch between the OC selling price and the cost sheet/BOM price marks the record Desynced (blue). The Desync tool in the Sales Order List (enabled only on a mismatch) syncs it: status Sync (green) and the OC price is overwritten with the cost sheet/BOM price, which is always the source of truth. A hyperlink opens OC Details with destination, delivery date, colour/size, OC price and cost sheet price. Needs the setting "OC Price Validation with selling price in cost sheet" ON.
where_used: Sales Order list; Sales › Purchase Order from buyer › Desync Price OC list
example: Cost sheet 10, OC typed 20 → desynced; sync sets the OC to 10.

name: Update OC with latest cost sheet price
definition: If the cost sheet price is revised and confirmed (for example 10 to 15), this action fetches the latest confirmed price and updates the OC selling price from 10 to 15.

name: Back Order
definition: Confirming an order with Fulfilment Type Back Order shows a New PO (GMPO) option on the OC, also reachable from the GMPO Pending List. From the GMPO the user generates the Material Requirement List (MRL), which creates the material indents from the BOM.

name: CM order
definition: For Order Type CM the OC Factory field is shown as Supplier (a mandatory dropdown from the Supplier Master, filtered by category). Confirming creates a GMPO per delivery for that supplier, listed in the GMPO Pending List, and the style indent appears in the Pending MRP List. The GMPO price is the Purchase Price (entered per colour or per size next to Selling Price), not the Selling Price. MRP fulfils the purchase demand automatically and the demand is locked.

name: Purchase order type
definition: Confirming a Purchase fulfilment order creates style indents in Indent Management. A manufacturing order can also be bought finished: after MRP Level 1 is the Style Indent and Level 2 the Material Indents, and the Purchase Demand field at Level 1 holds the style quantity to buy directly. On the next MRP run the material indents are reduced, or removed when the whole quantity is purchase demand, and an RMPO is raised on the style indent.
example: Order 1,000 with Purchase Demand 1,000: no material indents.

name: Make to Stock
definition: An MTS order (Order Type Make to Stock, Fulfilment Manufacturing) is produced and received into inventory, and no Sales ASN is created. A customer order with Fulfilment Type Purchase Order then takes that stock in Material Allocation (Sales Order Adjustment): the screen lists source MTS order, item, warehouse, available, allocated and balance quantity; allocation cannot exceed the available stock, and the same stock can serve several orders until it reaches zero.

name: Transfer Price mapping
definition: Before TP mapping the Order Company maps the Buyer (end customer) in Company Info and the Execution Company maps the Supplier. The mapping sits in FA › Master Definitions › AR Masters › Transfer Price › Default Transfer Price Mapping. Backward TP uses buyer, order and execution company and division, effective date, end customer and Price Applicable On (Default Margin % on FOB, Default Margin % on Material Cost in Internal Costsheet, Default Margin Rate, Default Selling Price). Forward TP uses based-on transaction, auto transactions, companies and divisions, supplier, fulfilment type and dispatch site.

name: Forward Transfer Price
definition: The order starts in the Order Company: Techpack, OC, approved costing and GMPO there; the system then creates Techpack, OC and an open costing in the Execution Company. After local purchase articles, costing approval, manual BOM, MRL, production, FPO and FPPO, Sales ASN and FG dispatch, the system creates the Sourcing ASN, Inter Purchase Invoice and Sales ASN in the Order Company.

name: Backward Transfer Price
definition: The order starts in the Execution Company: the OC takes the Execution Company default selling price and the system creates a GMPO/OC with the .Auto suffix in the Order Company. After procurement, production and Sales ASN (with execution company and ETD/ETA), the system creates the GMPO GRN, Supplier Invoice and OC Sales ASN in the Order Company; the user creates the Consignment Sales Invoice and does clearing and posting, and the system creates the Sales Invoice in the Execution Company.

name: TNA on the order
definition: A TNA template is attached per delivery or, in the list, Main OC wise (a count of articles with an info icon) or Style wise. Once confirmed it cannot be edited directly: Update TNA removes the template and reopens selection (only if one was attached), and Delete Track removes it (alert if none). Copy Below copies a template down. If an article is in several deliveries the earliest delivery date is used. Auto TNA attaches templates from TNA › Codes › Auto TNA Attachment Rules, still to be confirmed by the user.

name: EDI Buyer PO
definition: An electronic buyer PO imported and turned into a Buyer Order by configured mapping. Admin › Integration › Package Configuration (company, entity type, transaction type, package type Import/Export, SSIS package, folder path, active) and Package Mapping (WFX field, package field, mapping resolution type Data, System Data, User Input, Review & Create, Review & Map, Review & Resolve, Review & Select, plus dependency, mandatory, visibility, editable and sort order). On Sales › Purchase Order from Buyer › EDI Buyer PO: choose buyer and package, Import, pick the Excel file, Process Package, fix items in Error Resolution, then Create Transaction.
where_used: Sales › Purchase Order from Buyer › EDI Buyer PO

name: EDI Buyer PO tabs
definition: New (newly created orders), Revision (existing orders updated by EDI), On Hold (held manually, with Unhold) and Processed (confirmed). Delivery Detail opens the delivery level view and then the colour/size view; Confirm finalises the order and Export downloads the processed data.

name: Flex fields
definition: Fields created in Sales › Codes › Tracking Fields sync into the Flex Fields of the Other Details section.

name: Buyer Block Booking on the order
definition: Block booking type is Projection or Reservation. The BOM column lists approved BOMs of the article: with a BOM selected the material popup is filled from it and has no Add to Catalog tool; without one Add from Catalog is available. Generate Indent Requirement creates an Adhoc indent. Entering colour/size quantity is mandatory before Link Buyer Block Booking.
